---
title: "Study Area and Orthoimagery"
subtitle: "Transect from industrial Richmond to Pocahontas State Park"
date: today
---

```{r setup}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(leaflet)
library(yaml)
library(here)

cfg <- read_yaml(here("config.yml"))
derived <- here(cfg$paths$derived)

pts   <- st_read(file.path(derived, "aoi.gpkg"), layer = "transect_points", quiet = TRUE)
line  <- st_read(file.path(derived, "aoi.gpkg"), layer = "transect_line",   quiet = TRUE)
aoi   <- st_read(file.path(derived, "aoi.gpkg"), layer = "aoi",             quiet = TRUE)
tiles <- st_read(file.path(derived, "tiles_needed.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE)

# Status is checked at render time; tile paths are relative to the project root
tiles$converted <- file.exists(here(tiles$tif_path))
tiles$state <- case_when(
  tiles$converted          ~ "converted",
  tiles$status == "local"  ~ "local (not converted)",
  TRUE                     ~ "missing (download needed)"
)
state_cols <- c("converted" = "#1b9e77",
                "local (not converted)" = "#7570b3",
                "missing (download needed)" = "#d95f02")
```

## Purpose

This project uses 2025 Virginia Base Mapping Program (VBMP) orthoimagery along a transect
from industrial Richmond to Pocahontas State Park. The statewide imagery is distributed as
MrSID tiles. Only the tiles that overlap the study area are converted to GeoTIFF and combined
into a single virtual mosaic.

| Step | Script | Output |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Build transect and buffer | `R/01_build_aoi.R` | `data/derived/aoi.gpkg` |
| 2. Select intersecting tiles | `R/02_select_tiles.R` | `data/derived/tiles_needed.{gpkg,csv}` |
| 3. Convert MrSID to GeoTIFF | `python/convert_mrsid.py` (QGIS Python console) | `data/geotiff/*.tif` |
| 4. Virtual mosaic | `R/03_build_vrt.R` | `data/derived/ortho_12in.vrt`, `ortho_12in_preview.tif` |

All parameters live in `config.yml`. Analysis scripts load the imagery with `load_ortho()`
from `R/functions.R`, which returns the mosaic limited to the study area without copying
any data.

## Study area

```{r aoi-summary}
len_km  <- as.numeric(line$length_km)
area_km <- as.numeric(aoi$area_km2)
```

- **Start:** `r cfg$transect$start$name` (`r cfg$transect$start$lat`° N, `r abs(cfg$transect$start$lon)`° W)
- **End:** `r cfg$transect$end$name` (`r cfg$transect$end$lat`° N, `r abs(cfg$transect$end$lon)`° W)
- **Transect length:** `r sprintf("%.2f", len_km)` km
- **Buffer:** `r cfg$buffer$half_width_km` km each side, `r tolower(cfg$buffer$end_cap)` end caps
- **Study area:** `r sprintf("%.1f", area_km)` km²
- **CRS:** EPSG:`r cfg$crs` (`r st_crs(cfg$crs)$Name`)

```{r map-leaflet}
to_ll <- function(x) st_transform(x, 4326)
pal <- colorFactor(unname(state_cols), levels = names(state_cols))

leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Imagery") |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Light") |>
  addPolygons(data = to_ll(tiles), color = "white", weight = 1,
              fillColor = ~pal(state), fillOpacity = 0.4,
              label = ~paste0(tile_name, " (", state, ")"), group = "Tiles") |>
  addPolygons(data = to_ll(aoi), color = "black", weight = 2, fill = FALSE, group = "Study area") |>
  addPolylines(data = to_ll(line), color = "black", dashArray = "6", weight = 2) |>
  addCircleMarkers(data = to_ll(pts), radius = 5, color = "black", label = ~name) |>
  addLegend(pal = pal, values = names(state_cols), title = "Tile status") |>
  addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("Imagery", "Light"), overlayGroups = c("Tiles", "Study area"))
```

## Orthoimagery tiles

Tiles were selected by intersecting the study area with the VBMP 2025 12-inch tile
index footprints (South and North state plane zones searched).

```{r tile-summary}
tiles |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(state, name = "tiles") |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Status", "Tiles"))
```

```{r map-static, fig.width=7, fig.height=8}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = tiles, aes(fill = state), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_sf(data = aoi, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = line, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_sf(data = pts, size = 2.5) +
  geom_sf_label(data = pts, aes(label = name), nudge_y = 3000, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = state_cols, name = NULL) +
  coord_sf(datum = st_crs(cfg$crs)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = "Coordinates in EPSG:2925 (US survey feet)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### Tiles required to reproduce

To rebuild the data, download these MrSID tiles (`.sid` and `.sdw`) from the VGIN VBMP site
into `data/raw/tiles/`.

```{r required}
tiles |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(section = sub("^DO_(S\\d+_\\d{4})_.*", "\\1", tile_name),
         quarter = sub("^DO_S\\d+_\\d{4}_(\\d+)\\..*", "\\1", tile_name)) |>
  group_by(section) |>
  summarise(tiles = n(), quarters = paste(quarter, collapse = ", ")) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Section", "Tiles", "Quarter codes"))
```

```{r conversion, results='asis'}
log_path <- file.path(derived, "conversion_log.csv")
if (file.exists(log_path)) {
  log <- read.csv(log_path)
  cat(sprintf("**Conversion:** %d of %d tiles converted to GeoTIFF (%d errors logged).",
              sum(tiles$converted), nrow(tiles), sum(log$result == "error")))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("**Conversion:** %d of %d tiles converted to GeoTIFF.",
              sum(tiles$converted), nrow(tiles)))
}
```

## Mosaic

```{r mosaic}
vrt_path     <- file.path(derived, "ortho_12in.vrt")
preview_path <- file.path(derived, "ortho_12in_preview.tif")
has_mosaic   <- file.exists(vrt_path) && file.exists(preview_path)
```

```{r mosaic-info, eval=has_mosaic, results='asis'}
ortho <- terra::rast(vrt_path)
preview <- terra::rast(preview_path)
cat(sprintf(
  "The virtual mosaic combines %d GeoTIFF tiles into one %s × %s px image at %g ft resolution
  (bands: %s). It only references the tiles, so it takes no extra disk space.
  The preview below is resampled to %g ft pixels; the study area is outlined in yellow.",
  nrow(tiles), format(terra::ncol(ortho), big.mark = ","), format(terra::nrow(ortho), big.mark = ","),
  terra::res(ortho)[1], paste(names(ortho), collapse = ", "), terra::res(preview)[1]
))
```

```{r mosaic-preview, eval=has_mosaic, fig.width=6, fig.height=10}
terra::plotRGB(preview, stretch = "lin", mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
terra::plot(terra::vect(aoi), add = TRUE, border = "yellow", lwd = 2)
terra::plot(terra::vect(line), add = TRUE, col = "yellow", lty = 2)
```

```{r no-mosaic, include=!has_mosaic, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
cat("The mosaic has not been built yet. Run `R/03_build_vrt.R` after conversion.")
```

## Notes

- **Imagery source:** VBMP 2025 12-inch orthoimagery (Sanborn Map Company, flown February to March 2025),
  distributed by the Virginia Geographic Information Network (VGIN).
  The MrSID versions are RGB only. The near-infrared band is only in the TIFF deliverables.
- **Tile layout:** each 12-inch tile is 5,000 × 5,000 px at 1 ft, covering 5,000 × 5,000 ft.
  Tile names follow `DO_S13_<section>_<quarter>.2025`.
- **MrSID decoding:** the MrSID GDAL driver only loads inside the QGIS application
  (macOS code-signing blocks it from the command line), so conversion runs in the QGIS
  Python console.
- **Mosaic edges:** the VRT has no nodata value. Areas outside the tiles read as 0 in all
  three bands; all such areas lie outside the study area.
